name: sedan_7dct
source: Plausible 7-speed wet dual-clutch transmission for a 2.0 L passenger car, NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. Odd gears on one input shaft and clutch, even gears and reverse on the other; the next gear is preselected on the idle shaft. Ratios a near-geometric progression in the passenger-DCT range (1st ~3.6, 7th ~0.65; Naunheimer et al., Automotive Transmissions, 2nd ed., Springer 2011, ch. 6 - verify before citing). Efficiencies 0.96-0.98 [AS] (spur gearing like a manual plus wet-clutch drag). Shift clutches 350 N*m kinetic input-referred each [AS]; handover (torque phase) 0.06 s, inertia-phase bound 0.3 s [AS] (DCT shift times of tens to a few hundred ms); preselect 0.12 s for a gear not already waiting on the idle shaft [AS]. Launch on clutch slip and the creep torque are TCU data (automatic_tcu.launch, creep_torque_nm). Automatic gearbox plan A1.
